# Third-party files

These are inlined into every build by `build.py`. Nothing here was modified.

| File | What | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pixi.min.js` | PixiJS, the renderer | 8.22.0 | MIT (`PIXI-LICENSE`) |
| `pixi-unsafe-eval.min.js` | PixiJS add-on for pages that forbid `eval` | 8.22.0 | MIT |
| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP, the animation library | 3.15.0 | GreenSock standard licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `fredoka-700.woff2` | Fredoka Bold, Latin subset (from the `@fontsource/fredoka` package, 5.3.0) | | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`FREDOKA-LICENSE`) |

All four came from the npm registry through cdn.jsdelivr.net.

The word list the level is built from is ENABLE (public domain); it lives in word-tile-lab,
not here.
